# Payments: card gateway retries 5 → 3 with jitter (behind flag, default OFF)

**Ask:** 14-line review in `src/payments/retry.ts` before the release branch is cut **Thu 19 Nov, 17:00**. If it misses that, it waits two weeks.

**Where to look:** `computeDelay()` and the loop guard in `retryCharge()`. Everything else is the flag check.

**Why:** In last month's gateway brownout, 5 back-to-back retries from every pod tripped the gateway's rate limiter and blocked us for 11 minutes. Fewer retries with 0–250 ms random jitter spread out the load.

**Risk:**
- The change is behind `payments.retry_v2`, which defaults to **OFF**. Nothing changes until the flag is turned on.
- Rollback: turn the flag off. No deploy needed.
- 6 new unit tests in `retry.test.ts`: success on first try, success on retry 3, give up after 3, jitter bounds, flag off keeps the old behaviour, flag on uses the new behaviour.
- Staging, 2 days with the flag on: 0 retry-related errors, p95 checkout latency unchanged at 410 ms.

# Proposal: Two-week refactor of billing-sync

## The ask

2 engineers for 2 weeks (20 engineer-days), starting the sprint after next.

**Roadmap cost:** invoice PDF v2 moves 2 weeks later. No external date has been promised for it, so no customer commitment slips.

## Why now

Over the last 6 months, billing-sync has been the main source of instability and slow delivery on the billing team:

| | billing-sync | Rest of billing |
|---|---|---|
| P2 incidents | 7 of the team's 9 (78%) | 2 |
| On-call hours on those incidents | 46 | — |
| Average lead time for a change | 3.2 days | 1.1 days |
| Test coverage | 31% | 68–75% |

- **Reliability:** 7 of 9 P2s came from one module, all traced to retry and state handling. That is about 8 on-call hours a month spent on one known weak spot.
- **Delivery speed:** changes in billing-sync take roughly 3x as long to ship as changes elsewhere on the same team. Any roadmap item that touches billing pays this cost.
- **Root cause:** coverage is less than half that of the other billing modules, and the sync state machine is tangled into the HTTP handlers. Engineers move slowly because they can't easily tell what a change will break.

## What we will do

1. Split the sync state machine out of the HTTP handlers.
2. Add tests around retries and state transitions, the area all 7 incidents came from.
3. Raise billing-sync coverage from 31% to 70%, in line with the rest of billing.

The scope is fixed at 2 weeks. If it runs over, we stop at the end of week 2 and report where we got to; we will not extend without coming back to you.

## What we don't know

We can't promise incidents drop to zero. Our judgement is that most of the 7 would not have happened with the state machine separated and the retry paths tested, but we have no proof yet.

We are also not claiming this pays for itself on on-call hours alone: 46 hours over 6 months is less than the 20 engineer-days we are asking for. The case rests on reliability **and** delivery speed together. Billing-sync's 3x lead time slows every roadmap item that touches it, and that cost comes back every quarter.

## How we'll measure it

3 months after the refactor, we will report against the same baseline:

- P2 incidents traced to billing-sync (baseline: 7 in 6 months)
- On-call hours on those incidents (baseline: 46 hours in 6 months)
- Average lead time for a billing-sync change (baseline: 3.2 days, vs 1.1 days for other modules)
- Test coverage (baseline: 31%, target: 70%)

If the numbers don't move, that tells us something too, and we'll say so.

## Summary for the director

Two weeks of delay on a roadmap item with no external date. In exchange, we fix the module behind 78% of the team's P2s, the one that ships changes 3x slower than the rest of billing. Results will be reported against a clear baseline at 3 months.

- ภาพรวมการทดสอบ: ผ่านแล้ว 9 จาก 11 feature

| | เปิดตามเดิม (24 พ.ย.) | เลื่อน (27 พ.ย.) |
|---|---|---|

| พนักงานสาขา | ต้องจองคิวแทนลูกค้ากลุ่มนี้เอง | ไม่มีงานเพิ่ม |
| ค่าใช้จ่าย | ไม่มี | ไม่มี |

**ทีมแนะนำให้เลื่อน** เพื่อไม่ให้ลูกค้าเจอปัญหาตั้งแต่วันแรก และไม่เพิ่มภาระให้พนักงานสาขา

## สิ่งที่ขอ

**ขอให้ตอบอนุมัติหรือไม่อนุมัติการเลื่อน go-live เป็นศุกร์ 27 พ.ย. ภายในศุกร์ 20 พ.ย.** เพื่อให้แจ้งทุกสาขาล่วงหน้าได้ทัน
